fix_actions_taken.root_cause: golangci-lint v1.65.0 binary removed from GitHub Releases.
fix_actions_taken.fix: version v1.65.0 -> v2.10.0 (built with Go 1.26.0, earliest v2.x that satisfies setup-go@v5 go-version: 1.25 target). Pin golangci-lint-action to SHA 23faadfdeb23a6f9e511beaba149bb123b5b145a (=v6.0.0). Migrate .golangci.yml v1 schema -> v2 schema via `golangci-lint migrate`.
fix_actions_taken.verified_in_ci_run: 34815907654 — golangci-lint v2.10.0 binary downloaded, installed, executed (3 sequential runs)

fix_actions_taken.root_cause: Original quality-gate job swallowed downstream step results on failure.
fix_actions_taken.fix: Split into go_lint + go_build_unit_property + go_vulnerability_scan. quality-gate (back-compat aggregator) reads needs[].result and only PASSES on literal 'success'. Add required-gate for full owner-required path.

fix_actions_taken.root_cause: golangci-lint v2 in comma-list --build-tags (and .golangci.yml::run.build-tags list) treats all listed tags as AND-combined, pulling all cmd/lpbot/mode_*.go into one package. Each file declares validateMode() behind its own //go:build tag; with all tags active, three declarations collide.
fix_actions_taken.fix: 1) Drop run.build-tags from .golangci.yml (config-level AND removed). 2) CI workflow runs sequential 3-pass lint via plain run: shell loop: dryrun / shadow / live, one tag per invocation. Real compilation (Makefile build-dryrun/shadow/live) always uses single tag — three files are mutually exclusive — go_build_unit_property PASSes confirm.
fix_actions_taken.verified_in_ci_run: 34815907654 — step 6 golangci-lint sequential by build tag ran 3 times and exited non-zero on the 217 pre-existing findings, NOT on typecheck.
fix_actions_taken.commit: d39c50e (sequential 3-pass logic), 7dd4e64 (drop action wrapper, install binary directly via curl)

fix_actions_taken.root_cause: golangci-lint-action v6.0.0 treats `args:` as the args to `golangci-lint run`, not arbitrary flags. `args: --version` causes the inner lint invocation to fail.
fix_actions_taken.fix: Drop the action wrapper entirely. Install golangci-lint v2.10.0 directly via curl + tarball from official GitHub Releases to /usr/local/bin/golangci-lint, then a separate run: step loops the binary 3 times.
fix_actions_taken.verified_in_ci_run: 34815907654 — step 5 Install golangci-lint v2.10.0 → success; step 6 sequential lint ran.

fix_actions_taken.root_cause: python-rh-tests step 5 (full pytest) exit 2 caused step 6 (entry-point subset) to auto-skip within the same job.
fix_actions_taken.fix: Split entry-point subset into its own independent job python-rh-entry-points with no needs: dependency on python-rh-tests. Inject RH_RPC_PRIMARY/RH_RPC_SECONDARY/DATABASE_URL="" to validate no-send guards.

fix_actions_taken.root_cause: go-redis/v9 v9.7.1 within GHSA-92cp-5422-2mw7 / CVE-2025-29923 vulnerable range (>=9.5.1).
fix_actions_taken.fix: Minimal patch v9.7.1 -> v9.7.3. API surface used by runtime.go verified drop-in compatible via new internal/platform/redis/runtime_test.go (4 test funcs, all pass locally without needing a live Redis).

fix_actions_taken.root_cause: No explicit required aggregator — original overall FAILURE mixed real failures, skipped steps, downstream cancellations without distinguishing them.
fix_actions_taken.fix: Add required-gate job with if: always() that reads needs[].result for every required component (go_lint, go_build_unit_property, go_vulnerability_scan, python-rh-tests, python-rh-entry-points) and only PASSES on literal 'success'. No continue-on-error on required path.
